title: "Infinitely Often" Transcendence of Gamma-Function Derivatives
summary: Relatively little is known about the arithmetic properties of Gamma-function derivatives evaluated at arbitrary points $q\in\mathbb{Q}\setminus\mathbb{Z}_{\leq0}$. In recent work, we showed that the sequence $\left\{Γ^{\left(n\right)}\left(1\right)\right\}_{n\geq1}$ contains transcendental elements infinitely often. That result is now generalized to all sequences $\left\{Γ^{\left(n\right)}\left(q\right)\right\}_{n\geq1}$ for $q\in\tfrac{1}{2}\mathbb{Z}\setminus\mathbb{Z}_{\leq0}$.
